about_the_game:
We will be hosting a crowdfunding campaign. Pre-Release page out, find us on Kickstarter!

Project Mix is a VR anime narrative game.

Set in the red light district of Mong Kok, you play as Rone, a young former thug starting a new beginning to try leave behind his life of crime. He unexpectedly becomes a bartender after a chance meeting with Valencia, the eccentric bar owner of Eleventh Heaven.

At first, you live by the paycheck working at Eleventh Heaven, but as you find yourself hearing a bit too much for your own good, you find yourself thrown into a deep conspiracy.

Key Features:

  • Meet 8 unique customers and learn about the city from differing perspectives.

  • Shake, pour, decorate, and serve. Interactive bartending mechanics built from the ground up for VR.

  • What you choose to serve changes the lives of your clients, and even the game narrative.

    A focus on the small and subtle moments, such as having a smoke after work, sharing a drink, petting your cat.

    Explore the world through gorgeous and atmospheric environments featuring stylized anime visuals.

  • Heavy storytelling focus, visual novel narrative set in a rich cyberpunk world. There will be three romance paths.

  • Original soundtrack tailored especially for the game, ranging from jazz, synthpop to citypop.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon 400 Series or better
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • VR Support: HTC Vive, Meta, Valve Index
